goal: 修复 PR #7 深度审查发现的多会话状态污染、晚到 discovery 目录覆盖和动态 provider 默认模型启动问题

summary.title: Isolate router sessions and startup discovery
summary.what: Moved request, authentication, footer, route, health, circuit, timing, and adapter state into per-extension session contexts; made late discovery registration runtime-local and non-destructive; added provisional startup mirrors for runtime-only providers; and added Pi 0.84.4 integration coverage.
summary.why: Post-PR #7 review reproduced cross-session teardown failures, late discovery catalog replacement, and failure to resolve router/auto when upstream catalogs are only registered at runtime.
summary.user_goal: 修复 PR #7 深度审查发现的多会话状态污染、晚到 discovery 目录覆盖和动态 provider 默认模型启动问题

decisions.chose: Use AsyncLocalStorage-backed state captured by every session handler, provider stream, adapter callback, and timer.
decisions.rationale: This preserves synchronous helper APIs while preventing one AgentSession shutdown from clearing another session's registry or routing state.

decisions.chose: Coordinate bootstrap proposals through Pi's runtime-local extension event bus.
decisions.rationale: The event bus is scoped to the ExtensionRuntime and lets the active instance suppress late duplicate discovery without cross-runtime global ownership.
rejected: Relying on omitted streamSimple during provider merge

decisions.chose: Publish conservative provisional router model metadata, including router/auto, and replace it with runtime-derived metadata at session_start.
decisions.rationale: Pi resolves the default model before session_start, before runtime-only upstream catalogs can be observed by pi-router.
rejected: Waiting until session_start and allowing default-model resolution to fail

review_notes: Validation passed: TypeScript typecheck, 136/136 Vitest tests, build, verify.sh, and git diff --check.
Pi 0.84.4 ModelRuntime integration tests exercise pre-session router/auto selection, pending registrations, late duplicate catalog protection, and interleaved real AgentSession teardown.
Unrelated .mainline/local.toml and .ml-cache changes were left outside the source commit.

architectural_claims: Session-bound mutable router state is resolved through AsyncLocalStorage and captured by lifecycle callbacks.
Startup discovery ownership is scoped to Pi's ExtensionRuntime event bus rather than process globals.
Provisional startup catalogs exist only to satisfy pre-session model discovery and are rebound from the authenticated runtime registry at session_start.
behavioral_changes: Shutting down Session A no longer removes Session B's adapter or authenticated registry.
Late duplicate extension evaluation no longer replaces an active router model catalog.
router/auto and configured router models resolve before session_start for runtime-only upstream providers.

data_model_changes.name: provisionalModels
data_model_changes.migration_notes: Optional metadata; conservative defaults are used when omitted.

security_implications: Authentication registries and request credentials remain session-scoped and are not cached or reconstructed from auth.json.
Asynchronous registry replacement checks continue to fail closed.
migration_notes: No migration is required; provisionalModels is optional.
